objective: Tell matching rules and duplicate rules apart
stem: What does a matching rule do?

options.text: Defines how Salesforce decides two records are alike

explanation: A matching rule compares fields (exact or fuzzy) to identify possible duplicates. It does not take any action by itself.

objective: Tell matching rules and duplicate rules apart
stem: What does a duplicate rule do?

options.text: Defines what happens when a duplicate is found

explanation: A duplicate rule sets the action (alert, report or block) when a matching rule finds a match.

objective: Configure duplicate rules
stem: The sales director wants to stop reps creating a second account with the same name and city. What should the admin configure?

options.text: A duplicate rule set to Block that uses a matching rule

explanation: A matching rule alone only finds matches. A duplicate rule that points to it and is set to Block prevents the save.

objective: Tell matching rules and duplicate rules apart
stem: A duplicate rule needs something to compare records with. What must it reference?
explanation: Every duplicate rule is linked to one or more matching rules.

objective: Configure duplicate rules
stem: Which TWO actions can a duplicate rule take when it finds a match? (Choose 2)

options.text: Allow the save and show an alert

explanation: A duplicate rule can allow (with an alert and/or a report entry) or block. It never merges or deletes records for you.

objective: Configure duplicate rules
stem: An admin wants Salesforce to record possible duplicates so she can review them in a report later, without interrupting users. Which setting fits?

options.text: Allow, with the Report option turned on

explanation: Allow with Report logs the duplicate record items so an admin can report on them later.

objective: Tell matching rules and duplicate rules apart
stem: What is fuzzy matching?

options.text: Finding near matches such as Jon and John

explanation: Fuzzy matching finds similar values such as spelling variations and abbreviations. Exact matching needs identical values.

objective: Configure duplicate rules
stem: When does a duplicate rule run?

options.text: When a record is created or edited
Only when a record is deleted
Only when a user clicks Check Duplicates

explanation: Duplicate rules run on create and edit, and you choose the action for each.

objective: Configure duplicate rules
stem: A rule compares a new Lead against existing Contacts. Is this possible?

options.text: Yes, a duplicate rule can compare records across objects
No, rules only work within one object

explanation: Duplicate rules can compare a record against records in another object, for example Leads against Contacts.

objective: Find and merge duplicate records
stem: How many records can be merged in one merge action?
explanation: You can merge up to three duplicate accounts, contacts or leads, and you choose the master record.

objective: Find and merge duplicate records
stem: After a merge, what happens to the records that were not chosen as the master?

options.text: They move to the Recycle Bin and their related records move to the master
They become the master's child records

explanation: The master record keeps its place, related records are re-parented to it, and the other records are deleted into the Recycle Bin.

objective: Find and merge duplicate records
stem: Khanyisa Solar has 5,000 duplicate accounts that existed before any duplicate rule was created. Will activating a duplicate rule fix them?

options.text: No, the rule applies to new and edited records, so old duplicates must be cleaned up separately

explanation: Duplicate rules prevent or flag new duplicates on save. Existing duplicates need merging, or a data clean-up with Data Loader.

objective: Plan an ongoing data quality routine
stem: Reps keep creating duplicates by adding an "x" to the account name once the admin sets a Block rule on day one. What is a better rollout approach?

options.text: Start with Allow plus alert, review results, then tighten to Block where matches are strong
Switch off fuzzy matching and block everything

explanation: Users find workarounds when a rule blocks work they think is valid. Start with alerts, tune the matching, then block the clear cases.

objective: Layer validation rules, required fields and picklists
stem: Which setting forces a field to be filled in no matter where the record is created (UI, import or API)?

options.text: Marking the field required at the field level
Marking it required on one page layout
Placing it first on the page layout

explanation: A field-level required setting applies everywhere. Required on a layout only applies on that layout in the UI.

objective: Layer validation rules, required fields and picklists
stem: An admin makes Industry required on the Account page layout only. Which of these will still be able to save an account with no industry?

options.text: A data import or an API integration
A user on that page layout
A user using the same layout in Lightning
None, the layout rule applies everywhere

explanation: Layout-required is a user-interface setting. Imports and the API ignore it. Use a field-level required setting or a validation rule for a real guarantee.

objective: Layer validation rules, required fields and picklists
stem: What does a restricted picklist do?

options.text: Rejects any value not on the list, including values from imports and the API
Hides the picklist from some profiles
Allows only one value per user

explanation: A restricted picklist enforces that only listed values are saved, even through imports and integrations.

objective: Layer validation rules, required fields and picklists
stem: What is the purpose of a lookup filter?

options.text: To limit which records can be selected in a lookup field

explanation: A lookup filter restricts lookup choices, for example only active accounts, which keeps relationships clean.

objective: Layer validation rules, required fields and picklists
stem: The business wants Completion Date to be mandatory only when Status is Completed. Which tool fits best?
explanation: A validation rule can check a condition across fields and block the save with a message. A plain required setting would apply to every record.

objective: Plan an ongoing data quality routine
stem: How can an admin quickly find accounts that are missing an Industry value?

options.text: Build a report that filters for a blank Industry

explanation: A report with a filter for blank values makes missing data visible so you can fix it.

objective: Plan an ongoing data quality routine
stem: What is a data steward?

options.text: A named person responsible for the quality of a set of data

explanation: Good data quality needs ownership. A data steward is the accountable person for an object or data set.

objective: Find and merge duplicate records
stem: What is a duplicate record set?

options.text: A group of records Salesforce has identified as duplicates of each other
A set of records marked for deletion

explanation: When a duplicate rule logs matches, the related records are grouped in a duplicate record set that admins can review.

objective: Explain why bad data hurts reports, automation and AI
stem: Poor data quality affects which of the following?

options.text: Reports, automation and AI features that rely on the data
Nothing, because Salesforce corrects data automatically

explanation: Duplicates and missing values make reports unreliable and cause automation and AI features to act on bad information.

objective: Layer validation rules, required fields and picklists
stem: What does a dependent picklist do?

options.text: Limits the values of one picklist based on the value chosen in another
Copies a picklist to another object

explanation: A dependent picklist filters its values by a controlling field, which keeps combinations consistent.

objective: Manage duplicates
stem: Reps keep creating the same lead twice. The admin wants to warn them before saving. Which is correct?

options.text: A matching rule and a duplicate rule set to alert
A validation rule on every field

explanation: Duplicate rules use matching rules to find likely duplicates and can alert or block.
